sam: FYI perf alerted on ingress hosts 07:40 UTC: many tiny stream fragments causing a flurry of writev syscalls. 95p latency up.

jin: Any profile snippet? suspect microwrites + HPACK churn.

sam: From a quick sample: writev ~30% CPU, parse_fragment ~12%, kernel_picker_select ~9%, kv_cache_miss ~6%. Avg frame ~160B, 4-6 writev calls per response.

marta: KV miss rate bumped ~2% in same window. We had a pod eviction earlier that likely nudged eviction policy.

perf-bot: Summary: host ingress CPU peak 72%, median 20ms, 95p 410ms. Correlated with +2% kv misses.

alex: Quick staging tests: raising gateway coalesce from 128->512B lowered syscall count by ~40% and 95p -20ms. Forcing vector kernel for short seqs reduced CPU ~5% but tail unaffected.

jin: Actionable short fixes: (1) default ingress coalesce -> 512, (2) add --ingress-coalesce-delay-ms (0.5-1ms) to allow micro-coalescing, (3) pin kv cache size on canary to avoid eviction churn, (4) add telemetry mapping observed_ingress_frame_size -> kernel_id.

marta: I'll pin cache on canary and add an alert for kv miss delta >1%/5m.

sam: I'll open PR for proxy flags and a perf CI job that runs a small wrk stream script. Set rollback if 95p increases >10% or host token CPU +7% within 30m.

perf-bot: Perf job queued: nightly/ingress-coalesce-check.

alex: Assign owners: sam (proxy PR + CI), jin (kernel_picker telemetry), marta (kv pin + alerts). Recheck after 2h canary run. :thumbsup:
